sentences.en: I felt the terror of my neighbors after the earthquake.
sentences.zh: 地震后我感到了邻居们的恐惧。

sentences.en: Fadil's arrest brought an end to his reign of terror.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔被捕结束了他恐怖统治的时代。

sentences.en: The sound of the explosion made him freeze in terror.
sentences.zh: 爆炸声让他惊恐得呆住了。

senses.zh: 惊恐，恐惧；引起恐怖的人（或事物）；（尤指有政治目的的）恐怖活动，恐怖主义；<非正式>讨厌鬼，捣蛋鬼（尤指小孩）
